capabilities: Upload local attachments via a configurable CLI upload command
Auto-upload pasted screenshots and pasted or dropped files
Transfer remote HTTP(S) images in the current note to the host
Batch-migrate referenced attachments across the whole vault
Optionally delete local source files after links are replaced
disambiguation: Not a cloud sync or storage service itself; it shells out to a local upload tool such as uPic or PicSee that must already be installed.
extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop 1.14.4 or later; mobile is not supported because upload commands run as local executables. Shell pipelines and variable expansion in the upload command are unsupported.
problem: Obsidian stores attachments locally in the vault and offers no built-in way to upload them to an image host and swap the links to cloud URLs.

relations.evidence: Inspired by typora image upload functionality

requires.name: an upload tool with a CLI (e.g. uPic or PicSee) or a custom upload executable

summary: Uploads vault attachments to cloud hosting through configurable external upload tools like uPic and PicSee, replacing local links with URLs.
